root_idea.summary: The root centers on a bucket being sent down into a well and drawn out, with extensions to reaching or gaining access through a means.
root_idea.development: From the concrete movement of the bucket—lowering it, pulling it up, and using it to obtain water—figurative extensions develop for approach, access, presenting something to an authority, and related forms of descent or urging.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested verb form with its own descent and approach constructions.
Distinct Quran-attested Form IV verb with literal bucket and figurative authority-related uses.
Distinct Quran-attested noun meaning a bucket.

senses.definition: To descend or come down, with the sense of hanging or being lowered from above.
senses.usage_conditions: Quran-attested in the construction describing a descent from above; the related notions of hanging down and descending are treated together.

senses.definition: To draw near or approach, especially from above or after having been high.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quran-attested interpretation of the construction ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّى; the approach is associated with descent or movement from above.
An alternative Quranic interpretation of the construction ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّى, distinct from the interpretations of descent and approach.

senses.definition: To send a bucket down into a well, or draw it up or out, in order to obtain water.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with the bucket as the object in the well-drawing operation; the Quranic occurrence is interpreted as sending down the bucket, while the lexical discussion also records drawing it out.

senses.definition: To hand over or offer property to authorities as a means of obtaining a desired judgment, especially as a bribe.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction وَتُدْلُوا بِهَا إِلَى الْحُكَّامِ, the property is presented to judges to influence or secure a ruling, including by seeking what belongs to others.

senses.definition: A bucket or vessel used to draw water from a well.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic noun occurs in an inflected possessive expression meaning “his bucket.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pull a bucket up or out of a well, especially after it has been filled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the bucket as object, also in the construction بِالدَّلْوِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or demand the fulfillment of a want.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from pulling up the bucket.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask someone to intercede for one with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction in which a person is used as the means of access or intercession.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drive or urge on gently, making a creature proceed leisurely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical use describing gentle or leisurely urging.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat someone gently; to soothe, coax, wheedle, or conciliate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An interpersonal tropical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lower a thing, make it hang down, or let it fall into a pit or similar place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative Form II use for lowering or suspending an object or person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring, draw, or make a thing near to another thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative extension of bringing something within reach.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to fall into disobedience, ruin, or loss by deception; to excite desire or embolden by guile.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction بِغُرُورٍ is explicitly explained in the lexical evidence as a Quran-cited interpretation, but no corresponding QAC form group is supplied for it here.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To adduce, defend, or establish a plea or right, thereby obtaining one’s claim or suit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a plea, right, or similar claim as the matter adduced.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek access to or approach someone by means of kinship, and to plead or intercede through that relationship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Kinship is treated as the means by which access or intercession is sought, including kinship to the deceased.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To speak of someone in an evil or foul manner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction أَدْلَى فِيهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse or donkey, to put forth the penis for urination or mating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-related use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To descend upon someone with evil, mischief, or harm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction تَدَلَّى بِالشَّرِّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be driven or urged on gently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare quasi-passive or poetic use corresponding to the gentle urging expressed by دَلَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become lowly, humble, or submissive; to abase oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive or intransitive use describing lowered personal status or demeanor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hasten, speed, or go quickly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form XII usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sign of Aquarius, one of the signs of the Zodiac.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional astronomical use of the bucket noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hopper of a mill.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized technical use by resemblance or function.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mark made with a hot iron on camels, apparently in the form of a bucket.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized branding term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Calamity, misfortune, or mischief.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiomatic use, as in bringing calamity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A share or portion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited poetic example applies the word to a share of affection, but the lexical meaning is stated more generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who pulls a bucket up or out of a well; in poetry, one who lets a bucket down.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participle noun with both pulling-up and poetic letting-down uses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A water-drawing irrigation device, such as a water wheel or bucket assembly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of devices operated by an animal, water, or a rope-and-bucket arrangement to irrigate land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land irrigated by means of a bucket or water-drawing machine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transferred use referring to the land served by the device.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hanging unripe dates, eaten when ripe; more generally, hung fruit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural use associated with fruit hanging from a tree.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A variety of black, though not intensely black, grapes, borne in large hanging bunches.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural name for a grape variety.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A grapevine or a shoot of a grapevine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use distinct from the water-drawing apparatus.
